title: Winter storm: Minnesota school closures, e-learning days for Thursday, Feb. 19 - NewsBreak
text:
By Adam Uren ,
9 hours ago
Schools have started to announce cancellations and e-learning days as a winter storm continues to pummel Minnesota midweek.
More than a foot of snow had fallen along Minnesota's North Shore by Wednesday lunchtime, with double that still possible by the time the system exits the region on Thursday.
It's combined with high wind gusts of up to 60 mph, causing treacherous travel conditions across the state.
